claims.statement: A telegram reported that Mace of London was matched to fight Tom Allen for $5,000 a side; Allen's friends and backers in St. Louis denied any such arrangement.
claims.excerpt: Mace of London is matched to fight Tom Allen for $5,000 a side, as announced by telegram

claims.statement: It is said that Tom Allen will not go back on his offer to accommodate any man in the world with a fight inside the ropes, but wants time for preliminaries.
claims.excerpt: Allen does not go back on his generous proposition to accommodate any man in the world

notes: Report of a telegram, denied by Allen's backers. Much of the article is garbled OCR; the date of the telegram is not given.
